notes: Fastned graph for the Opel Ampera-e (the European Chevrolet Bolt EV 60 kWh), 22-92 % SoC, 50 kW class chargers, battery near 30 C. 44-46 kW to 50 % (peak 46.2 kW at 52 %), drops to 39-40 kW at 55-65 %, 27.5 kW at 70 %, 23-24 kW at 75-85 %, 16 kW at 90-92 %. Step-downs near 55 % and 68 % match the published Bolt behaviour (Wikipedia: 55 kW tapering to 38 kW at 56 % and 24 kW at 68 %). The Ampera-e was limited to 50 kW; the North American Bolt can pull up to 55 kW, so the absolute level may be a few kW higher. No data below 22 %. Low confidence: European Ampera-e on 50 kW chargers, a sibling of the NA Bolt (same pack and charge hardware), not a Bolt test. Peaks at 46 kW against our 55 kW estimate (50 kW chargers), and there is no data below 22 %. Whether the dc_max is 50 or 55 kW is an open question for the owner.
